status.label: Status
status.hint: Hidden quests are invisible to players. Any other status shows the quest to everyone.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Players see this name, even without access to the actor.

img.label: Portrait
img.hint: Shown next to the quest title and in the list.

location.label: Location
location.hint: Where it happens. Links like @UUID[…]{Nachglut} work.

description.label: Description
description.hint: What the group knows. Players see this as soon as the quest is revealed.

hook.label: Hook
hook.hint: How do the players stumble into it - without a marker?

approach.label: What the group can do
approach.hint: The goal and two or three ways to get there.

choice.label: The choice
choice.hint: Which decision without a right answer waits at the end?

reward.label: Reward
reward.hint: What does the group get - and what does it cost?

secret.label: Secret
secret.hint: Which secret of the world does it touch - and who knows: the players, the characters, nobody?

Edit.GiverHint: Drag an actor from the sidebar onto the portrait: name and image are filled in.
Edit.DropActorOnly: Only actors can be dropped here.
Edit.ObjectivesHint: Players only see revealed objectives. Optional objectives don't count towards progress.
Edit.BriefHint: Only you see this, but it is not encrypted: a player who opens the browser console could read it. Turn on Settings → Motherboard: Quest Log → Secret mode.
Edit.BriefEncrypted: Only you see this. Encrypted when saved - only your browser knows the secret word.

Paste.Title: Paste quest profile
Paste.Hint: Paste one quest profile from your notes (Markdown, e.g. Obsidian): lines like **Aufhänger:** …, **Wer will was:** … or the English labels (**Hook:**, **Who wants what:** …). The heading above becomes the quest name. Links and bold are turned into plain text. Fields found replace what is there; the others stay.
Paste.NoFields: No quest profile fields found. Expected lines like **Aufhänger:** … or **Hook:** …

Secret.Name: Secret mode
Secret.Label: Secret mode
Secret.Hint: Stores the GM brief of every quest encrypted, so players can't read it - not even through the browser console.
Secret.Explanation: Foundry sends every journal page to every player. Hiding a page doesn't stop someone who opens the browser console. In secret mode the GM brief is only stored encrypted. The key comes from your secret word, which stays in this browser and never reaches the server. Use the same word as in the Data Carrier module and you only need one.
Secret.NoCrypto: This browser has no Web Crypto (Foundry must be served via HTTPS or localhost).
Secret.WordHint: At least 8 characters. Without the word nobody can read the briefs again - not even you. Every brief written so far is encrypted right away.
Secret.UnlockHint: Secret mode is on, but this browser doesn't know the secret word yet.
Secret.Forget: Forget the word in this browser
Secret.TurnOffQuestion: Every GM brief is stored readable again. Players could read them through the browser console.
Secret.TooShort: The secret word needs at least 8 characters.
Secret.WrongWordStored: Quest Log: the secret word stored in this browser doesn't match. Enter it again under Settings → Motherboard: Quest Log → Secret mode.
Secret.EnterWord: Quest Log: enter your secret word under Settings → Motherboard: Quest Log → Secret mode to read the GM briefs in this browser.
Secret.NotSetUp: Quest Log: the GM briefs are not encrypted yet. Turn on Settings → Motherboard: Quest Log → Secret mode.
Secret.Locked: Encrypted - enter the secret word under Settings → Motherboard: Quest Log → Secret mode.
Secret.GMOnly: Only the GM can read this.
Secret.SetUp: Secret mode is on. {n} GM briefs are encrypted.
Secret.SetUpShared: Quest Log: secret mode is on, with the Data Carrier's secret word. {n} GM briefs were encrypted.
Secret.Unlocked: Secret word accepted - the GM briefs are readable in this browser.
Secret.TurnedOff: Secret mode is off. {n} GM briefs are readable again.

View.GiverNoAccess: You don't have access to this actor.

Keybinding.Toggle: Open or close the Quest Log
